_comment_catalogs: Official scheduler-automation feed and the index of official catalogues. Point these at a tunnel (cloudflared/ngrok) to test against a BCWEB that is not the production domain.
_comment_analytics: Telemetry (opt-in). analytics_key is a PUBLIC ingest key: it only permits SUBMITTING telemetry and already ships inside the app. Keeping both here means the collector can be moved, or the key rotated, without waiting for a BMM release. Empty analytics_endpoint = events stay buffered locally and nothing leaves the machine.
_comment_source: BMM fetches this file BCWEB-first (https://bettercommunity.ch/api/assets/links.json), then the GitHub copy, then this bundled local file. Edit the canonical copy under BetterCommunity → Admin → Downloads & assets.
_comment_rpc: Discord Rich Presence buttons. Button 1 = 'Website' (its URL gets ?creator=<id> appended at runtime). Button 2 = 'GitHub'. BoutonRPC1 picks which WebSiteRPC link (1 or 2), BoutonRPC2 picks which github_RPC link (1 or 2).
